intro:

This cheerful platform puzzle game challenges you to nudge all monsters off the platforms using your funny friends' special skills. With its colorful visuals, addictive gameplay, and easy-to-use controls, Mixed World Weekend is a must-play for fans of puzzle platformers. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or looking for a new challenge, this game is sure to provide endless entertainment.

    The core premise of Mixed World Weekend is simple: use your friends' special skills to nudge the monsters off the platforms. With a variety of friends to choose from, each with their unique abilities, you'll need to think strategically to solve each level. From the straightforward to the mind-bendingly complex, Mixed World Weekend's levels are designed to test your skills and keep you on your toes. With its addictive gameplay, colorful visuals, and easy-to-use controls, this game is perfect for players of all ages and skill levels.

    But what really sets Mixed World Weekend apart from other puzzle platformers is its focus on community and social sharing. With the ability to share your progress on social media, compete with friends, and join daily challenges, this game is designed to be fun and engaging for players who enjoy sharing their experiences with others.
